topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I walked through the door, and there she was, packing boxes with the care she put into everything. The room felt lighter, airier than usual, as if the walls had shifted a little to accommodate the growing space between us. She told me, simply, as if she was sharing a recipe or a joke. Moving across the country, she said, like it was just another layer in the tapestry of our lives. I nodded, watching the sun slide across the floor, casting shadows that danced. We sipped tea, the kind we always drank, and talked about everything and nothing, the way we always did. It was going to be different, sure, but the sky was still blue, and the sun still warm. We’d make it work, just as we always had.
